PROVISIONS
Touch: in the Depot, your left thumb moves and the Jump button jumps · drag anywhere to turn the camera, pinch to zoom · in a zone, tap a card, then tap a lit tile
The Depot: WASD move · Space jump · Shift dash · Q / E or right-drag turn the camera · wheel zoom. Walk onto a zone's grid to take the job. The first zones you play on foot; from Zone 4 (and on the water) you play in your car or boat, and so do the enemies
A run: head north from the Depot. Each zone is its own walled-in location with a grid in the middle; clear its job and the gate at the far end opens onto a town. Your kit (your deck) and energy come with you. Lose a job and the run is over
Rides: the first three zones you play on foot. From Zone 4 your car is your piece on the grid (your boat, in a water zone), its turret does the zapping, and what you catch piles into the back. Out of a job you're on foot, except on open water: walk in and you're in your boat. The Garage (cars) and the Dock (boats) in the Depot sell rides and turrets for cash
Cards: you own a collection and take a deck of up to 15 (MY DECK). Each zone deals you 7 from it. In a zone, PROVISIONS shows 5 more from your deck: energy grabs one into your hand. Card Shops sell new cards for cash or Pearls. The Card Library lists every card
Towns and the Depot: walk onto a booth's pad. The Card Shop swaps a card in your kit for energy, Loot Crates hold blasters and skins, the Quest Board lets you swap a quest. Walk up to another player and press TRADE to swap blasters and skins
Quests (top right): done just by playing. They pay energy, or a free loot crate
A job: beat the quota of enemies before you run out of turns. Each turn you get to play every card in your hand once, in any order: 1-7 or click a card, then click a lit tile. Esc or right-click cancels. Enter / Space ends your turn
Enemy turn: every enemy grows one stage: CONFUSED? → STRONG → AIMING! (or WOUND UP!). One that's about to attack takes a heart: shooters shoot you from where they stand, the rest jump over, hit you and jump back. Then it calms down to STRONG for a turn. If anyone's still standing they whistle, and more turn up: they walk on from beside their spot or parachute down. You have 2 hearts (they come back when you finish a battle). Out of hearts: the run is over
Drops: a beaten enemy drops nothing, an egg or a card. Eggs are rarer the sooner you beat it (confused = rare, strong = epic, about to attack = common) and hatch into pets when the round ends. Eggs go straight into your collection. Equip one pet or companion in My Pets: it follows you and gives you its power (one more heart, energy every morning...)
Cards: Movement, Attack and Utility. Walk and run moves pass over tiles (and pick up energy on the way) but can't climb a hill. Hops, jumps and leaps can, and landing on a pet from a hill catches it outright. Teleports go anywhere in range
Height: hills are 8 studs up. Only lobbed zaps reach a pet above you, and a hill blocks a beam fired from the ground. From a hill, beams and swipes hit bugs below
Energy: cells drop onto the field in ones and twos every turn. Walk over one to pick it up (your wallet holds 10). Spend it in the Module Shop: the new card replaces one in your deck, used or not, and is ready right away. A lobbed shot on a cell blows it up and zaps every pet next to it
Drop spots: dirt marks show where enemies will turn up on the enemy turn. Stand on one and nobody comes
